_note: 2_R03 'Paper Route' — the repeatable rich-neighborhood delivery job, v1 (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_R03-paper-route.md — the 2_R* ids are town jobs, NOT races; the recon flags the original assignment guess as wrong). **No PaperRoute.DAT / Mailboxes_Rich.DAT was ever extracted** — the route plays across 2_04's rich-neighborhood geography (borrowed trigger file), with the seven mailboxes as stationary target dummies at that file's own beach-head cluster points (the mailbox props aren't drivable world props — same posture as 1_04/2_S02/2_05). TIER DECISION: single-tier v1 in the tier-0 tutorial shape (35 s hilltop dash, 7 deliveries) — the difficulty ladder is indexed by GetMissionSuccessCount('2_R03_X') in the original, our completion is one-shot and the campaign has no cross-run counter, so repeatable_job_tiers is recorded as pending (attempt counts are per-launch retries, not success counts — deliberately not abused). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the vendor intro NIS is a speech beat; the mission bike (delete-current + grant + auto-mount) is skipped (vehicle_grant pending — the route is on foot); a delivered paper is a smashed target dummy, not a projectile-hit mailbox (deliverable_target_props pending); the per-paper payout accumulates into one $14 pass reward (7 x $2 — money_reward_accumulator pending; the original pays 200 cents per paper through the banner + stat 171); ALL hazards are skipped (dogs/cars/rival mailmen/eggers/old-lady gag — hazard_randomizer + vehicle_hazard_controller pending); the out-of-papers grace fail and the short-of-quota timer fail are skipped (no ammo economy); population/vehicle/bus-stop overrides are skipped. No SMissPass entry (VERIFIED absence). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
